mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRODUCT ( TITLE, CATEGORY, PRICE, DESCRIPTION, SELLER_ID, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, IMAGE_PATH, PLACE_NAME ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{category}, #{price}, #{description, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{sellerId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{latitude, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{longitude, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{imagePath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{placeName, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT PRODUCT_ID, TITLE, CATEGORY, PRICE, IMAGE_PATH, VIEW_COUNT, LIKE_COUNT, STATUS, CREATED_AT FROM PRODUCT WHERE CATEGORY = #{category} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCT SET VIEW_COUNT = VIEW_COUNT + 1, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
UPDATE PRODUCT SET LIKE_COUNT = LIKE_COUNT + 1, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
